### Problem

The report in #2442 describes a defect, and the reproduction confirmed it: a fixed test written from the report fails on the default branch at `06633adbbf504b7934393b38fee1a1f8fdd05f21` (https://github.com/DiluxOne/diluxone-test/actions/runs/44510685983).

Reproduction test: `tests/repro/test_issue_2442.py`, SHA-256 `b1227ddae9b706fac914e18aeb6ab7a326095ac96c4dfd93c08ac43a6dddea7b`, on the branch `test/repro-issue-2442`.

Reproduction way: `fixed`, run by scripts/repro-run.sh as `{"junit":"build/repro-2442.xml","minutes":5,"run":"python3 tests/repro/test_issue_2442.py","test":"tests/repro/test_issue_2442.py"}`.

The test is the specification: it asserts what the report expected. It was written from an outsider's text, so it runs only the way it was written, in the reproduction's sandbox (scripts/repro-run.sh: the way's setup before the test is in the tree, then the test alone as a user of its own, with no environment, no secrets and no network but the machine's), never in the autopilot's working tree.

### Scope

- Fix the defect the reproduction test exercises, in the code it exercises.
- Add the reproduction test to the default branch, exactly as written.

### Out of scope

- Changing, moving, skipping or deleting the reproduction test: it is the evidence, and gate G7 checks its SHA-256.
- Any other behaviour the report mentions that the test does not exercise: a new issue.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given the reproduction test tests/repro/test_issue_2442.py exactly as written, when it runs on the fix, then it passes, where it failed on 06633adbbf50.

### Criticality

Normal
